=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:698-704, 716-722 | confidence=4 (2 related items)
  PROBLEM: The fallback chain adds `steps.checkout_ref.outputs.ref` as the first element, but it resolves to the same value as the existing `steps.refctx.outputs.ref` chain, and when `SKIP_IMPLEMENT` is true both the producer and consumers are skipped so the empty-output case cannot occur.
  WHY: `checkout_ref` already emits the default ref and the shared `if: env.SKIP_IMPLEMENT != 'true'` guard prevents the new prefix from changing runtime behavior.
- tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:79-92 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `/git/ref/heads/` disallowed marker was moved from the shared audit check applied to all `REQUIRED_RESOLVER_WORKFLOWS` to only `implement.yml`.
  WHY: Future additions of `/git/ref/heads/` resolution patterns in any workflow other than `implement.yml` would bypass the audit check.
